title: Hero Academy: Be a Superhero!
description:
Auto Card Update! Meet 11 custom homeroom classmates and enter the Academy of Heroic Development—the world’s most elite training ground for superheroes. Against all odds, you’ve been chosen. Now, you must navigate a school of legends, unlock your potential, and face challenges beyond imagination. Will you join Class Ardent to rise to the occasion, or will the weight of destiny crush you?

Auto Cards are up and running thanks to the amazing Auto Cards script by the incredibly talented @LewdLeah!

Part of the Nexusverse. (30+ Story Cards!)
prompt:
Humanity stood on the edge of annihilation.

And so, the Superhero Nexus was formed—a global network of heroes designed to organize the defense of Earth. From the youngest, most inexperienced recruits to battle-hardened titans, the Nexus calls upon every available warrior to protect humanity from forces beyond imagination. You, however, are just beginning your journey.

Your powers began manifesting so you turned to the Academy of Heroic Development. For the first time, there was a place designed not just to hone powers but to help individuals like you find their place in the world. With its legendary .2% acceptance rate, it felt like an impossible goal. Still, something deep inside urged you forward—a whisper of hope, barely louder than a breath.

And against all odds, you were accepted.

Now, you stand before the gates of the Academy, towering monuments of polished steel and glowing circuitry. The air buzzes with anticipation, the weight of countless legends who walked these grounds before you, pressing down on your shoulders. Class Ardent with Dr. Calista Vayl, Mnemosyne, is your homeroom. That's your destination within the Academy. As all the other freshmen, adjust your uniform and begin walking within for your first day.

This is it. The start of your new life.

cardPool.title: Superhero Nexus
cardPool.value:
The Superhero Nexus is an elite coalition of global superheroes, united to safeguard humanity from emerging threats—both terrestrial and cosmic. Their headquarters is in Bastion Central. [Heroes are ranked from Omega-Rank down to E-Rank, with Omega being the strongest and E-Rank being a trainee.]
[Protected Cities: Sovereign, Newbridge, Sunnyside, Brookline, Silverdale, Zenith City, Aegis City, Hyperion, Chronopolis.]

cardPool.title: Sovereign
cardPool.value: Sovereign, a sprawling urban jungle where towering skyscrapers pierce the sky, their glass facades reflecting the ever-present glow of neon lights. A city that never sleeps, it hums with life, energy, and danger. On the surface, it’s a technological marvel—hover cars zoom along elevated highways, holographic billboards flash advertisements for everything from the latest hero gadgets to interplanetary travel, and sprawling markets thrive under the city’s endless night. But beneath the glitz and the cutting-edge facade lies a city on the edge, where chaos and heroism dance in constant conflict.

cardPool.title: Bastion Central
cardPool.value: Bastion Central is the beating heart of global superheroism and the most advanced metropolis on Earth. As the central hub of the Superhero Nexus, it serves not only as the organization's headquarters but also as the epicenter of power, innovation, and governance for a world teeming with superpowered beings. A city of shining spires, state-of-the-art technology, and powerful heroes, it stands as a beacon of hope to the world—and a fortress against the threats that seek to destroy it.  Every corner of City 1 exudes a sense of power and purpose, where the world's most powerful beings come to train, govern, and protect the planet.

cardPool.title: Brookline
cardPool.value: Gleaming and modern, Brookline sits on the coast, offering a perfect blend of urban luxury and natural beauty. Its towering glass structures and hero training academies attract elite heroes from across the world. However, with great wealth comes danger—villains often target its lavish districts, and sea monsters occasionally emerge from the deep, making the oceanfront a dangerous yet scenic battleground.

cardPool.title: Newbridge
cardPool.value: Shrouded in perpetual twilight due to its dense atmosphere and high pollution, Newbridge is a place of mystery and danger. Known for its underground black markets and villain activity, the city is a hotspot for shadowy heroes who operate in the gray area of morality. The dimly lit streets are lined with neon signs and hidden alleys, where the line between hero and villain often blurs.

cardPool.title: Sunnyside
cardPool.value: Known for its towering defenses and militaristic design, Sunnyside is a fortress-city constantly under siege from monstrous invasions and villain attacks. High walls and force fields encircle the city, while its interior is a sprawling network of bunkers and battle-ready zones. Heroes stationed here are always on high alert, and the air crackles with tension as every day feels like the next battle is just around the corner.

cardPool.title: D-Rank
cardPool.value: [The D-Rank is given to superheroes who are sidekicks, or actively training.]

cardPool.title: E-Rank
cardPool.value: The E-Rank is given to trainees who are taking the Superhero Evaluations.

cardPool.title: C-Rank
cardPool.value: [The C-Rank is given to superheroes who can patrol neighborhoods and streets alone or in groups to prevent small-time crime or minor threats.] [The C-Rank is given to threats who are capable of hurting groups of people.]

cardPool.title: A-Rank
cardPool.value: [The A-Rank is given to superheroes capable of defending neighborhoods and sectors of cities by themselves.] [A-Rank threats are capable of leveling parts of a city.]

cardPool.title: S-Rank
cardPool.value: S-Rank sits right below Omega-rank. [Superheroes who are capable of defending cities on their own are given this rank.][Threats with this rank are capable of destroying cities.]

cardPool.title: Monster
cardPool.value: Creatures that have emerged from dimensional rifts or been created through scientific experiments gone wrong. They range from mindless destructive entities to highly intelligent beings with their own complex societies and motivations. Their strengths ranging from C-Rank threats (dangerous but manageable) to S-Rank and Omega-Rank (catastrophic and nearly unstoppable).

cardPool.title: Silverdale
cardPool.value: Silverdale is built inside a hollowed-out mountain, with structures extending both up and down. Famous for its underground hero training facilities and monster containment chambers. The city's population is known for having the highest percentage of latent superhuman abilities.

cardPool.title: Zenith City
cardPool.value: Zenith City is built atop massive anti-gravity platforms 3000 feet above the ground. Originally designed as a refuge from Monster attacks, it's now a major center for aerial hero training. The entire city can split into smaller, mobile sections during emergencies.

cardPool.title: Aegis City
cardPool.value: Aegis City is a city that completely rebuilds its layout every month using AI-driven modular architecture. This constant change makes it nearly impossible for villains to plan attacks but requires citizens to rely on augmented reality navigation. Home to the most advanced predictive crime AI system.

cardPool.title: Hyperion
cardPool.value: One of the few cities without visible defenses, instead relying on psychological warfare and empathy-based technology. Known for its successful rehabilitation programs for both Monsters and fallen heroes.

cardPool.title: Chronopolis
cardPool.value: A sprawling port city with floating districts and underwater habitation domes. Known for its advanced early warning systems against aquatic threats and alien incursions. Home to the controversial "Deeptech Labs" which studies recovered alien technology.

cardPool.title: Next Wave
cardPool.value:
Next Wave is a small group of young teenage superheroes operating in Chronopolis. Led by Blazeheart, they undo team or solo missions.

Secret base is hidden in an old arcade called Pixel Paradaise.

cardPool.title: Supervillain
cardPool.value: These aren't merely criminals, but complex actors with their own motivations. Some seek to exploit the corporate world for personal gain, while others genuinely believe their actions will protect humanity from greater threats.

cardPool.title: Alien
cardPool.value: These are the most unpredictable entities. Some seek conquest, others mere scientific observation, and some have motivations so alien that human comprehension remains impossible.
